# Where AI might plug in

## A neural network as a component?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- The `rt` slot holds a prior model for $R_t$. Today that is an AR
  process. It could hold a network
- A universal differential equation puts the network on the residual
  dynamics, the mechanism we cannot write down
- Philipps et al.: the network "consistently hindered parameter
  identifiability", and fitted mechanistic parameters "did not match
  the published values"
- No neural network code in any EpiAware package. Maybe nothing doing
  there at the moment
- What would you put in the slot?

::: {.attribution}
Philipps, Schmid and Hasenauer (2025), npj Systems Biology and
Applications,
[PMC12398592](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12398592/) ·
Rackauckas et al. (2020),
[arXiv:2001.04385](https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.04385) ·
Grep of the EpiAware organisation for Lux and Flux, 2026-09-11
:::
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}

## Agents building and checking the parts

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="44%"}
- [BVDOutbreakSize][bvd]. Bundibugyo virus disease, DRC, 2026. A
  replication of the McCabe et al. report of 18 May, in a few hours the
  next day. Refit on every push since, 145 releases by 9 September
- The situation reports are French PDFs. Agents read them, two blind
  readers each. 333 of 425 pull requests, the unit of proposed change
  on GitHub, came from my bot account
- SitRep 087: the chart's y axis changed from steps of 20 to 25. Caught
  only because it broke the reporting-triangle invariant
- What would convince you a part an agent built is right?

::: {.attribution}
[github.com/epiforecasts/BVDOutbreakSize][bvd], `README.md` and
`data/README.md:77-111` · Release and pull request counts from the
GitHub API, 2026-09-11
:::
